coachView.description: Timeline widget for displaying BAW process activities with status tracking, assignee information, and duration metrics

configOption.name: processInstanceId
configOption.label: Process Instance ID
configOption.description: BAW process instance ID to automatically fetch activity data (e.g., '2072.1072'). Leave empty to use manual data binding.

configOption.name: baseUrl
configOption.label: BAW Base URL
configOption.description: BAW server base URL for API calls (default: current server)

configOption.name: showTimestamps
configOption.label: Show Timestamps
configOption.description: Display timestamp information for each activity

configOption.name: compact
configOption.label: Compact Mode
configOption.description: Use compact spacing for timeline activities

configOption.name: clickable
configOption.label: Clickable
configOption.description: Enable click interaction on timeline activities

configOption.name: activityClicked
configOption.label: Activity Clicked
configOption.description: Event fired when a timeline activity is clicked
